# Frost Law Group, LLC

> Frost Law Group, LLC is a husband-and-wife law firm in Summerville, South Carolina handling estate planning, probate and criminal defense for families in Dorchester, Berkeley and Charleston counties. Personal injury cases are handled at summervilleaccidentattorney.com.

- Address: 128 Linwood Lane, Summerville, SC 29483
- Phone: (843) 419-6653
- Hours: Mon–Thu 9–5 · Fri 9–12 · Friday afternoons by appointment
- Attorneys: Jack C. Frost (criminal defense; former Summerville police officer and Charleston County Sheriff's Office detective) and Tara L. Frost (probate and estate planning; former Dorchester County magistrate and associate probate judge)
- Personal injury matters: https://www.summervilleaccidentattorney.com/
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=6320073536186250254
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/frost-law-group-summerville
